Name: AP
Text: Targets get -X to Defense rolls when blocking hits from this weapon.

Name: Ambush Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Ambush.

Name: Ambushing Piercing Shot
Text: Counts as having Ambush, and its weapons get AP(+1) when shooting on the round in which it deploys via this rule.

Name: Bane
Text: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

Name: Bane in Melee Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Bane in melee.

Name: Bane when Shooting Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Bane when shooting. 3

Name: Battleborn
Text: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

Name: Blast
Text: Ignores cover, and after resolving other special rules, each hit is multiplied by X, where X is up to as many hits as models in the target unit.

Name: Casting Buff
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 12" with Caster, which gets +1 to casting rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Counter
Text: Strikes first with this weapon when charged, and the charging unit gets -1 total Impact rolls per model with Counter.

Name: Courage Aura
Text: This model and its unit get +1 to morale test rolls.

Name: Dangerous Terrain Debuff
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Deadly
Text: Assign each wound to one model, and multiply it by X. Hits from Deadly must be resolved first, and these wounds don't carry over to other models if the original target is killed.

Name: Destructive
Text: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

Name: Evasive
Text: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where all models have this rule.

Name: Furious
Text: When charging, unmodified results of 6 to hit in melee deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

Name: Furious Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Furious.

Name: Havocbound
Text: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, or when it charges, its weapons get AP(+1).

Name: Havocbound Boost
Text: If this model has Havocbound, it always gets AP(+1) from Havocbound (instead of only when shooting over 9" away, or when charging).

Name: Havocbound Boost Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Havocbound Boost. 3

Name: Impact
Text: Roll X dice when attacking after charging, unless fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes one hit.

Name: Indirect Mark
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Indirect against once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Infiltrate
Text: Counts as having Ambush, but may be deployed anywhere over 3" away from enemy unit.

Name: Lacerate
Text: When attacking the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

Name: Melee Shrouding
Text: Enemies get -3" movement to a min. of 6" when trying to charge units where all models have this rule.

Name: Melee Shrouding Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Melee Shrouding.

Name: Mend
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly model within 3" with Tough, and remove D3 wounds from it.

Name: Mobile Artillery
Text: When this model uses a Hold action and shoots at enemies over 9" away, it gets +1 to hit rolls. As long this model hasn't moved during the round, when enemy units shoot at it from over 9" away, they get -2 to hit rolls.

Name: No Retreat
Text: When a unit where most models have this rule fails a morale test that causes it to be Shaken or Routed, the test counts as passed instead. Then, roll as many dice as the number of wounds it would take to fully destroy it, and for each result of 1-3 the unit takes one wound, which can't be ignored.

Name: No Retreat Aura
Text: This model and its unit get No Retreat.

Name: Piercing Assault
Text: This model gets AP(+1) when charging.

Name: Piercing Assault Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Piercing Assault.

Name: Piercing Warrior
Text: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, or when it charges, its weapons get AP(+1).

Name: Protected
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

Name: Protection Feat
Text: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and all its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

Name: Protection Feat Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Protection Feat.

Name: Rapid Advance
Text: This model moves +4" when using Advance actions.

Name: Rapid Rush
Text: This model moves +6" when using Rush actions.

Name: Rapid Rush Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Rapid

Name: Ravage
Text: When it's this model's turn to attack in melee, roll X dice. For each 6+ the target takes one wound.

Name: Re-Deployment
Text: After all other units are deployed (excluding units that were set aside), you may remove up to two friendly units from the table and deploy them again. Players alternate in placing Re- Deployment units, starting with the player that activates next.

Name: Re-Position Artillery
Text: Once per activation, pick one friendly model within 6" with Artillery, which may immediately move by up to 9".

Name: Reanimation
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule is activated, roll as many dice as the max. number of models/wounds it could restore. For each 5+ you may restore one model/wound. Note that new models may only be restored if they can be placed in coherency with non-restored models.

Name: Reanimation Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Reanimation.

Name: Regeneration
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

Name: Regeneration Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Regeneration.

Name: Relentless
Text: When this model shoots at enemies over 9" away, unmodified results of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

Name: Relentless Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Relentless.

Name: Reliable
Text: Attacks at Quality 2+.

Name: Rending
Text: Ignores Regeneration, and on unmodified results of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

Name: Repel Ambushers
Text: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

Name: Resistance
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored. If the wounds were from a spell, then they are ignored on a 2+ instead.

Name: Resistance Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Resistance.

Name: Scout Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Scout.

Name: Self-Repair
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 6+ it is ignored.

Name: Self-Repair Boost
Text: If all models in this unit have Self- its unit get Unstoppable when shooting. Repair, they ignore wounds on rolls of 5-6 from Self- Repair (instead of only on 6+).

Name: Self-Repair Boost Buff
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Self-Repair Boost once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Shielded
Text: Units where all models have this rule get +1 to defense rolls against hits that are not from spells.

Name: Shred
Text: On unmodified results of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

Name: Spawn
Text: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it.

Name: Steadfast
Text: If a unit where all models have this rule is Shaken at the beginning of the round, roll one die. On a 4+, it stops being Shaken.

Name: Steadfast Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Steadfast.

Name: Stealth Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Stealth.

Name: Surge
Text: On unmodified results of 6 to hit, this weapon deals 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

Name: Swift
Text: This model may ignore the Slow rule.

Name: Swift Buff
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Swift once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Thrust
Text: When charging, gets +1 to hit rolls and AP(+1) in melee.

Name: Tough
Text: This model must take X wounds before being killed. If a model with tough joins a unit without it, then it is removed last when the unit takes wounds.

Name: Unpredictable
Text: When attacking, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

Name: Unpredictable Fighter
Text: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1), and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

Name: Unstoppable
Text: Ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers to this weapon.

Name: Unstoppable Mark
Text: Once per activation, before attacking, pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Unstoppable against once (next time the effect would apply).

Name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
Text: This model and Triangulation Bots (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Indirect when shooting against once (next time the effect would apply). Piercing Bots (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(2). Inspiring Bots (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Rapid Advance once (next time the effect would apply). Flame Bots (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Mending Bots (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Self-Repair Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Gauss Bots (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Destructive. Roll as many dice as hits to see if "on rolls of 6" effects trigger.

Name: Versatile Attack
Text: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation, when shooting or charging enemies over 9" away, all models with this rule in this unit either get AP(+1) or get +1 to hit rolls.

Name: Versatile Defense
Text: When a unit where all models have this rule is deployed or activated, pick one effect: when shot or charged from over 9" away, the unit either gets +1 to defense rolls, or enemy units get -1 to hit rolls against it. This effect lasts until the 12", which get Shred in melee once (next time the units' next activation.

Name: Versatile Defense Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Versatile Defense. Cursed Stride (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which counts as being in Dangerous Terrain once (next time the effect would apply). Havoc Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 2 hits with AP(2). Dark Assault (2): Pick up to two friendly units within effect would apply). Havoc Terror (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Havoc Boon (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Havocbound Boost once (next time the effect would apply). Havoc Fog (3): Pick one enemy unit within 12", which takes 6 hits with AP(1) and Shred.

Name: Versatile Reach
Text: When this unit is activated, pick one effect: until the end of the activation all models with this rule in it either get +4" range when shooting, or move +2" when charging.

Name: Versatile Reach Aura
Text: This model and its unit get Versatile Reach. Advanced Sight (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which friendly units gets Unstoppable when apply). Cerebral Trauma (1): Pick one enemy unit within 18", which takes 1 hit with Blast(3) and Lacerate. Blessed Ammo (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Lightning Fog (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Protective Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Psychic Terror (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Bane.
